intended_behavior: This function should robustly parse file names from the chat output and sanitize them by removing extraneous formatting characters such as backticks (`) and square brackets ([]), in addition to the currently removed special characters. This will ensure that file names are clean and consistent regardless of GPT model output formatting differences, thus preventing malformed file names like '`filename`' or '[filename]'. The content extraction logic should remain unchanged to preserve file contents integrity.

This function should continue to delegate file name and content extraction to `parse_chat` and map them correctly into the workspace. It may remain unchanged if `parse_chat` adequately fixes the filename formatting issue. If further adjustments are needed, they should ensure correctly formatted filenames are used as keys without extraneous characters.
